lesson.title: A fresh pie question
lesson.subtitle: P4 pie-chart revision
lesson.objective: Find how many are not in one group of a pie chart.
lesson.story: The pie chart shows 60 pupils in all, sorted into Tea, Milk, Juice and Water.

steps.title: Find what is left
steps.prompt: The pie shows 60 pupils in all. How many pupils are not in the Tea group?
hints: The whole pie is made of every group together.
Work out how many slices are not Tea, then use what one slice stands for. Or find the number in Tea and take it away.
The pie has 12 slices and Tea covers 5, so 7 slices are left. Each slice stands for 5.

steps.title: Explain your thinking
steps.prompt: Why can you take away to find the rest of the pie?

choices.label: The whole is made of every group, so taking one away leaves the rest.
Taking away only works when the known group is half of the pie.
The rest is always the biggest group, so find the largest sector.

hints: Think about what the whole pie is made of.
Every group is a part of the whole.
Take one part away and the other parts are left.
Choose the explanation about the whole being made of every group.
